title: bromus mollis var. simplicissimus
intro: Bromus mollis var. simplicissimus, commonly known as Smooth Brome, is a type of perennial grass native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory function. The therapeutic actions of Smooth Brome include its ability to calm coughs and relieve congestion, making it a popular remedy for respiratory issues. Its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, contribute to its medicinal properties.
